summary: Frontend-only testing on the Supreme House nav/layout changes + new Cabina Panoramica tab. 16/16 Playwright checks passed across desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Ticker removed, hero (2 cols) ok, bottom-nav mobile has 5 voices (Home/Immobili/Servizi/Profilo/Menu — no 'Accedi'), side drawer opens with all links, closes via link click and via side-menu-close. Profilo redirects unlogged users to /accedi. Admin login (admin/admin123 via choose-login → role-admin) succeeds and redirects to /dashboard. /cabina-di-regia opens with Panoramica active by default; the four stat cards (ov-leads=7, ov-props=7, ov-newsletter=0, ov-buyers=8) show real data from GET /api/admin/overview and the 'Ultime richieste' list renders. Regressions on /immobili, /servizi, /chi-cerca pass; no horizontal overflow at 390px; no runtime errors in console.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' every time the mobile side-menu opens. Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle inside SheetContent in components/layout/Navbar.jsx (SideMenu).

action_items: Add a VisuallyHidden <SheetTitle> (e.g. 'Menu laterale') inside SheetContent of the mobile SideMenu to silence the Radix DialogTitle a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardSection ov-props/ov-newsletter use onNavigate to switch Cabina tabs (region/newsletter) — functional, but the testable 'navigation' is a tab change, not a route change. If a URL-based deep link is desired, consider syncing the active tab to a querystring.
Navbar.jsx SideMenu Sheet is missing a SheetTitle — Radix prints an a11y error every open.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — login flow verified end-to-end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All focus-area changes from this iteration (ticker removed, 2-col hero, 5-tab mobile bottom-nav with side drawer, Panoramica tab in Cabina) are working. Admin credentials admin/admin123 valid. GET /api/admin/overview returns leads_total, leads_new, properties_active, properties_total, newsletter, buyer_requests, buyer_requests_pending, recent_leads — all consumed by DashboardSection. Only remaining nit is the Radix DialogTitle a11y warning on the mobile side menu Sheet.
